advice: I abstain. The supplied evidence does not identify a cache bottleneck or justify another distinct cache-blocking change. The baseline already traverses 64-row by 32-column blocks; row-half-first traversal and other traversal/layout variants were measured without promotion. I propose no new blocks or pointer mapping.
risks: A new traversal or packing layout could add timed data movement or regress performance. Any future proposal needs a distinct source change and must be evaluated with ten validation reports, ten fresh alternating paired controls, the unchanged promotion gate, and the held-out check. The supplied results do not establish cache causality.
